newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia may sign De Beers deal in November.
newsitem.headline: Russia may sign De Beers deal in November.

text.p: Russia and South African diamond group De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd may sign a final export agreement next month, Interfax news agency quoted a diamond official as saying on Wednesday.

It quoted Almazy Rossii-Sakha first vice-president Lev Safonov as saying that he expected the government to approve final details of a three-year export deal in November and the two sides to sign a deal immediately.
Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS, or Diamonds of Russia-Sakha) is Russia's largest diamond producer and sole authorised exporter.
ARS officials had said earlier this month that a new deal could be signed by the end of this month.
The text of the agreement that will allow Russia to export diamonds is being examined by the Finance and Economy Ministries and must be approved by Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.
The final agreement will be based on a memorandum signed in February by the two sides under which De Beers will take roughly half of Russia's diamond output.
